name: The Condor Heroes 95
description: The Condor Heroes 95 is a Hong Kong television series adapted from Louis Cha's novel The Return of the Condor Heroes. It was first broadcast on TVB Jade in Hong Kong in 1995. Many of the cast from The Legend of the Condor Heroes reprised their roles in this series, such as Lau Dan and Wayne Lai. In addition, Jason Pai reprised his breakthrough role as Kwok Ching, whom he previously portrayed in The Legend of the Condor Heroes and The Return of the Condor Heroes.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview:
Fifteen years ago, LUK JIN YUEN abandoned LEE MOK SHOU. He even made SHOU hurt by a monk, KUO WING. SHOU hates YUEN deeply. Now it is time for her to take revenge.

WING again helps YUEN to get rid of SHOU. However, WING is hurt by SHOU's poisoned needle. YUEN asks MAO SAM TONG to inform YUEN. SAM will go crazy occasionally. It is because YUEN's wife, KWAN, is very similar in appearance to SAM's ex-lover.

SAM's wife, LEUNG, brings her sons, YU and MAN to YUEN's home. SHOU leaves nine blood stained palm's marks at YUEN's home. KWAN and YUEN commit suicide in front of SHOU. SHOU fears of SAM's 'Powerful Finger' and leaves. YUEN's daughter, SHEUNG, does not know that her parents had already died.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview:
YU, MAN, SHEUNG and YING stay at GOU's cave and eat his food. GOU demands them to pay. SHOU follows SAM and his wife to GOU's cave. She wants to kill YUEN to vent her anger. SAM is being defeated and is hurt by her poisoned needle. GOU helps them to escape from danger. However, the two girls are still being caught by SHOU.

GOU carelessly touches the poisoned needle. AU YEUNG FUNG rescues GOU with the condition that GOU regards him as father. Later, FUNG even teaches GOU his special martial art' The Toad Stance'.

KWOK CHING and WONG YUNG meet GOU. YUNG believes that he is YEUNG HONG's son. SAM's wife had died; CHING thus brings GOU, YU and MAN to the Peach Island. They hope that GOU could grow up at the Peach Island.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview:
GOU does not like YU and MAN who always curry YING's favour. YU, MAN and GOU play the 'cricket game'. FU beats GOU's cricket to death. GOU slaps FU angrily. YU and MAN beat GOU for FU's sake. YU, MAN, FU and GOU become CHING's pupils. YUNG teaches GOU by herself. However, she only teaches GOU poem and never teach him martial art.

Half year later, YU and MAN want to compete with GOU. GOU is nearly being defeated. GOU uses 'The Toad Stance' taught by FUNG to strike back during the emergency. He makes MAN faint. YUNG decides to send GOU to the North Hill and learn martial arts from the TSUEN TSANG Sect.

CHING is being misunderstood as an erotomania when he arrives the North Hill. He fights against the TSUEN TSANG people. Later, they know that it is a misunderstanding. CHING helps the TSUEN TSANG Sect to deal with FOK DUO and DAT YEE BAR.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview:
TSUEN TSANG Sect leader, YAU CHU KI, tells CHING their Sect history and explains why they have to help the girl with the family name, LUNG. CHING hurries to the tomb. Meanwhile, LUNG is using the bees to drive FOK DUO away.

GOU formally joins the TSUEN TSANG Sect. CHIU CHI KING is GOU's master. KING takes the chance to take revenge and beats GOU. DUK also plays trick on GOU. GOU decides to leave the Sect secretly but he is being arrested instead. The temporary leader, PING, punishes GOU by asking him to work in the kitchen.

DUK shirks his responsibility and asks GOU to send lunch to the prisoners, HOI, FU and TIN. GOU finds the three very familiar. GOU questions them and knows that they are his father's subordinate. He set them free with the condition that they told GOU who had killed his father. GOU finds that the murderers were CHING and YUNG.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: KING claims that he will teach GOU martial arts. In fact, they only teaches him the theory. Half a year later, KING asks GOU and DUK compete with each other. GOU is seriously hurt by DUK. GOU again uses 'The Toad Stance' to strike back during the emergency. GOU immediately flees away. He carelessly bursts into the tomb. GOU, KING and the others are attacked by the bees. GOU is fainted. Aunt SUEN saves him and brings him into the tomb. SUEN begs LUNG to let GOU stay. LUNG refuses. SUEN brings GOU to the TSUEN TSANG Sect and negotiates with them for GOU. Y AT TAI TUNG blocks their way. SUEN is seriously hurt by YAT. LUNG arrives. SUEN begs LUNG to take care GOU before she died. LUNG agrees. LUNG forces YAT to kill himself. YAT cannot defeat LUNG and follows her order. However, YAU arrives in time and stops YAT. LUNG brings GOU and SUEN's dead body back to the tomb.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: LUNG starts to teach GOU martial arts. She asks GOU to sleep on the 'Cool Jade Bed' so as to accelerate his progress. LUNG wants to practice the TSUEN TSANG Sword Stance together with GOU. However, she has no guide for this stance. GOU recalls that KING had forced him to recite some theory. They eventually get the clue. They start to practice the TSUEN TSANG Stance. While LUNG is practicing, PING and KING are fighting with each other loudly. Their disturbance hurts LUNG. LUNG knows that she is going to die. She drives GOU away. GOU meets SHOU's apprentice, HUNG LING BAL who has asked GOU about the way to the South Hill. She forces GOU to be her escort. GOU is more cautious when he finds that they aim at LUNG. HUNG wants to hurt LUNG. GOU suddenly stops HUNG by manipulating her vein flow. However, SHOU arrives, LUNG asks GOU to switch on the mechanical trap.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: LUNG and GOU escape away form SHOU for a few times. However, LUNG returns due to the Sect regulation. She always asks GOU to leave her. When she has learnt that GOU is determined to stay with her, they are being locked in the tomb. They enter the coffins and wait to die. Unexpectedly, they find a notice at the coffins. They follow its instruction and enter a private chamber. There is an article regarding how to overcome the martial arts of the Virgin Bible and the Kow Yam Bible in the chamber. There is also a map which hinted the way to leave the tomb. LUNG and GOU practice hard and eventually learn part of the martial arts of the Kow Yam Bible and the Virgin Bible. One day, FUNG finds GOU. He forces GOU to learn martial arts from him. He suppresses LUNG by manipulating her vein flow. PING sees that LUNG could not move for the moment, he covers her eyes and rapes her. LUNG thinks that it is GOU's deed. She wants GOU to marry her……

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: LUNG leaves. GOU misses LUNG a lot. He heard that there is a girl with a white coat who has been to a restaurant and had hurt a few Taoist priests. GOU then stays at this restaurant hoping that LUNG will return. In fact, the girl is not LUNG. She is LUK JIN YUEN's daughter, SHEUNG. She is very similar to LUNG in appearance. Thus, GOU thinks that she is LUNG and follows her all along. SHEUNG is a fugitive who tries to avoid her master. GOU helps her to escape from danger all the way. Later, the TSUEN TSANG Taoist priests break her ribs. GOU helps her to fix her rib. GOU gets a chance to live in a Mongolian army camp. He helps YUEN NGAN PING to defeat YA LU CHI. GOU thus gets the chance to stay with a group of beautiful girls.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview:
SHOU catches SHEUNG. GOU, NGAN PING and YIN chase SHOU. The two groups fight against each other fiercely. Later, CHI and YING arrive. SHOU is exhausted. YING eventually got the chance to suppress BAL and rescues SHEUNG. FU arrives with MAN and YU. SHOU fears that CHING and YUNG will come and escapes away. They have a drink together. FU regards SHEUNG as servant. GOU  GOU meets LUNG. They are so happy that they ignore the people around and hug with each other intimately.

and SHEUNG leave together. GOU leaves SHEUNG and goes to find LUNG alone the next day. He arrives the WAH Mount and meets HUNG CHIT KUNG. KUNG introduces GOU to eat centipede. They meet the 'five ugly guy' from Tibet. KUNG pretends to be dead. GOU risks his life to protect KUNG's dead body. KUNG leaves a very good impression on GOU. Later, FUNG appears. He fights against KUNG fiercely. However, FUNG goes so crazy that he even cannot remember who he is.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: KUNG and FUNG fight for a very long time. They are very exhausted and are eventually died. CHING and YUNG arrange a meeting for the Beggar Sect. They arrange LO YAU GUR to succeed KUNG's place. GOU meets the TSUEN TSANG Taoist priests. He is very impolite to them. YUNG is pregnant. GOU transfers his energy to YUNG. YUNG is surprised to see that GOU is so strong. The people do not know that KUNG had been passed away during the Martial Art Meeting, they elect KUNG to be the leader. However, they still have to elect the second leader. FUK DUO, TAT YEE BAR follow the KAM LUN Monk to the meeting. They agree that the one who win two games out of three will become the second leader. YUNG is in a very difficult position.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: CHING sends CHU CHI LAU and MAO SAM TUNG to fight against DUO. However, they are soon defeated by DUO. DUO disturbs GUO and LUNG. GUO fights against DUO and BAR. Later, CHING defeats them with the 'Defeating Dragon Palms'. GUO refuses to CHING's marriage proposal. He leaves with LUNG. FU scolds GOU. GOU ignores her. Later, FU is caught by the Enchanter. YUNG tries to save FU but is in vain. GOU and LUNG join together to rescue FU. YUNG invites them home for dinner. YUNG talks with LUNG for a long time. LUNG leaves GOU the next day. GOU again goes everywhere to search for LUNG. GOU and YUNG again meet the Enchanter. They are in a very dangerous position as LUNG is not around.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview:
YING again appears during emergency and rescue them. Later, WONG YUK SZE introduces his new pupil, YING, to YUNG.

The Mongolian troop penetrates into the SHEUNG YEUNG City. CHING and YUNG hurry to fight against the enemy.

MAO SHEUNG arrives. She and YING fancy GOU secretly. GOU takes off YING's mask and discovers that she is a pretty lady. SZE appreciates GOU and becomes a good friend of him. He even teaches GOU martial arts.

GOU forces 'Stupid KUO' to tell him who was the murderer of his parents with the 'hide and seek' game. Stupid KUO only remembers the name of the murderer is KUO KUO. Since SZE has left, SHOU does not leave the blood-stained palm mark. GOU thinks of using a palm of 'Big Scissors' to deal with her.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview:
The blacksmith is also SZE's people, FUNG MAK FUNG. He also joins in to confront against SHOU. SHOU's dust remover is burnt. She fails to defeat them.

GOU disguises as ghost to scare KUO. He then knows that CHING and YING are those who killed his parents.

CHOW PAK TUNG did not pay after having meal at a restaurant. He is chased by the owner of the restaurant. He forces LUNG to teach him how to sleep on a string. LUNG hurts herself during practicing martial arts as she misses GOU too much. She is fainted and falls down from a slope. The owner of the  'Cruel Valley', KUNG SUEN CHI, discovers LUNG. He brings her back to the valley. He heals LUNG with some precious medicine. LUNG changes her surname to LAU after awakened. CHI cheats LUNG to marry him. CHOW follows CHI's pupil, YANG, to the valley. CHOW tries to stop LUNG marrying CHI.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview:
LUNG is determined to marry CHI. CHOW disturbs the valley. GOU asks the Enchanter to help him killing CHING and YANG. The Enchanter reminds GOU that his martial arts is not good enough. GOU creates his own style. The Enchanter brings GOU to see FA BE LIT. LIT appreciates GOU's talent. CHOW is chasing by YANG and arrives. He again makes disturbance before LIT. YANG uses fishing method to arrest CHOW and brings him to the valley. GOU and the others follow them to the valley. LUNG begs CHI to set CHOW free. CHI states that he will only set CHOW free after he got married. LUNG then sets CHOW free secretly. CHI's daughter, AU, meets GOU. GOU :flatters AU with sweet words. GOU is carelessly pierced by the poisoned flowers. He feels very painful. CHOW cuts YUNG' s beard. He even takes off all her clothing to prove that he is innocent.

AU and GOU fall into a cave, they meet a handicapped woman, TSE, at the cave. TSE is, indeed, AU' s mother……

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview:
LUNG and CHI meet GOU just a minute before they got married. LUNG denies that she knew GOU at the beginning. Later, she is moved by GOU's passion. She joins force with GOU to fight against CHI. However, they are hurt by the poisoned flowers and are being arrested. LUNG agrees to marry CHI so as to save GOU.

AU knows that her father is not right. Thus, she sets them free and goes to find some antidotes for them. They meet CHI at the medicine room. CHI wants to kill AU. GOU tries to stop CHI. Unfortunately, AU an GOU are being trapped and fall down to a cave.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview:
GOU tries hard to climb up from the cave. He then tries to pull TSE and AU up. YUNG suddenly attacks GOU. Fortunately, TSE could suppress YUNG in time.

TSE arrives in time. She tells all heroes about TSE's bad deed during his wedding ceremony. CHI is very angry. He fights against TSE. Later, CHI flees away after TSE had made him blinded.

GOU gives the only antidote to LUNG. TSE requires GOU to bring CHING's head back within eighteen days so as to take revenge for his elder brother. She gives GOU half piece antidote. She will only give him another half after he finished his job. GOU goes to the Sheung Yeung City to find CHING. YUNG sees through GOU's intention. CHING suddenly woke up when GOU tries to kill CHING.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview:
CHING thinks that GOU has hurt himself when practicing martial arts. He the transfers most of his energy to GOU. Next day the refugees arrive to Sheung Yeung City. CHING opens the gate and fights against LAU and SAM. CHING is very weak. He is in a very dangerous position. GOU is moved by CHING who is benevolence towards the poor, GOU thus risks his life to save CHING. YUNG sees through LUNG and GOU who had bad intention on CHING.

MAN and YU try to kill FA so as to curry FU's favour. However, they are being arrested instead. FA asks CHING to go. GOU goes with CHING. When CHING, GOU and FA are going to leave after the negotiation, the Enchanter and the others arrive aiming to kill CHING. GOU does not lend a helping hand to CHING at the beginning. Later, GOU's conscience is moved. He risks his life to lend a helping hand. However, he cannot defeat the enemy. Fortunately, FUNG MAK FUNG uses fire to rescue them……

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview:
CHING and GOU are being saved and are sent back to the Sheung Yeung City. YUNG and FU feel grateful with GOU's help. CHUNG is seriously hurt and need a long time for recovery. YUNG asks LUNG the truth. LUNG tells YUNG about the poisoned flower. YUNG agrees to give them her head to exchange for the antidote for GOU after she had gave birth to the baby.

The Enchanter arrives to get CHING. GOU fight against the Enchanter. He hurts the Enchanter with his sword. However, the Enchanter has already ordered his people to set fire. YUNG is going to give birth. She gives birth to a baby girl, SHEUNG, at the beginning. LUNG brings SHEUNG away to exchange for the antidote. After LUNG has gone, YUNG gives birth to a baby boy. LUNG meets the Enchanter, they then start a hard fight. Soon SHOU arrives, they start a big fight for the baby. GOU suddenly hands over the baby to SHOU.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: GOU and SHOU flee into a cave. The Enchanter is hurt by SHOU's silver needle. SHEUNG is hungry. GOU finds a leopard to provide milk for SHEUNG. SHOU treats SHEUNG as her own daughter. GOU and SHOU see MAN and YU are fighting with each other. GOU deliberately irritates them and claims that he is engaged to FU. LUNG heard the conservation. She is very upset. SHOU hurts SAM and TUNG with her silver needle. GOU is aware that he is going to die very soon, thus, he sucks out the toxic substances form SAM TUNG. LUNG says good-bye to CHING and wishes FU and GOU could have a happy future together. She heard PING and KING's conservation before she left. She finds that PING is the one who raped her. She questions PING to prove the case. LUNG leaves immediately after she had knew the truth. MAN and YU bring GOU back. Meanwhile, the monk from India is present. He tries to nullify the effects of poison for GOU.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview:
MAN and YU tell FU what GOU had said. FU is very angry. She questions GOU. GOU admits and tries to explain. However, FU ignores him and chops GOU's left hand. GOU picks up his limb and leaves. CHING wants to kill FU. YUNG stops and hides FU up.

GOU meet the condor who is struggling against a snake. GOU helps the condor and kills the snake. The Condor finds that GOU was hurt. It gives the gall of the snake to GOU. It even brings GOU to the 'Sword Devil' DUO KUO KOW BY's tomb and forces GOU to practicing swordsmanship with the 'YUET TAT Sword'.

LUNG follows PING and KING to a restaurant. They meet the Enchanter. When the Enchanter is going to kill LUNG, CHOW PAK TUNG arrives.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview:
TUNG and the Enchanter make a bet on stealing the army flag. TUNG and LUNG leave. The Enchanter buy off KING. He advises KING to tell TUNG the location of the army flag so as to curry his favour. The Enchanter then puts a spider next to the flag. YUNG is bit by the spider. LUNG rescues TUNG and flees into a cave with her golden needle. However, the Enchanter uses TUNG to be the covering. Fortunately, the toxic substances in the needle and the spider could counteract each other. TUNG's condition even gets better. TUNG teaches LUNG how to uses both her left and right hands smoothly. LUNG uses her bees to kill the big spider. TUNG and LUNG could then leave the cave. The Enchanter cannot defeat LUNG and flees away. LUNG decides to go back to the tomb.

GOU succeeded in practicing some wonderful martial arts at the FUNG LUI Valley.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview:
GOU has eventually completed his extraordinary swordsmanship. He cheers with the Condor and leaves. He aims to take revenge on FU and searches for LUNG.  GOU arrives Sheung Yeung City. CHING is also searching for FU. CHING rebukes FU. GOU follows CHING home. He is moved to see that CHING wants to chop FU's left arm for compensation. However, YUNG stops CHING and brings FU away.

YUNG meets SHOD. She finds that SHOU is with SHEUNG. She suppresses SHOD. However, GOU brings SHEUNG away. GOU meets FU. He lets FU go as he thinks of CHING's patronage. CHI meets CHAI, YIN and PANG. He finds YING and PANG are very pretty and indecently assaults them.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview:
CHAI comes to rescue YIN and PANG. However, he is being defeated. Later, MAN YU, SAM TUNG, YUNG and SHOU arrive. CHI immediately flees away. They all go to the South Hill to find GOU.

GOU brings SHEUNG to the tomb. However, he cannot find LUNG. He heard there is disturbance at the TSUEN TSANG Sect. He thus hurries to the spot. PING becomes the leader of the TSUEN TSANG Sect. KING threatens PING to give up the position to him. PING obeys KING. KING accepts the Mongolian's offer. PING and other members revolt against KING. LUNG comes to kill PING but she has to kill KING first. KING asks the Enchanter for help. The Enchanter is defeated by LUNG. GOU sees LUNG and hugs her. The Enchanter takes the chance to hurt LUNG. GOU defeats the Enchanter. PING commits suicide.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview:
Ep24

The bees chase TUNG to the CHUNG YEUNG Palace. LUNG and GOU hide themselves at the library. Later, GOU even helps LUNG back to the tomb by hiding her at a wooden box

TUNG uses a bell to lock KING up. Later, he attracts the bees to attack KING. YUNG and the others arrive the South Hill. In fact, CHAI is TUNG's pupil.

GOU and LUNG get to know the benefit of the 'Chilling Bed' from the Old Grand Master. With FUNG's theory, GOU knows how to heal LUNG.

SHOU brings everybody to the tomb. However, YUNG and PANG do not join them. SHOU immediately lock everybody up after entering the tomb. She goes to see GOU and LUNG. GOU uses SHOU to help him cure LUNG. GOU even devises to lock SHOU up at the stone coffin.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview:
LUNG is releasing her toxic substances at the tomb. GOU brings SHEUNG away. SHOU breaks the coffin. YUNG goes to the Cruel Valley with everybody.

GOU and LUNG shelter at a hut during a heavy fall of snow. Later, the monks, YAT TANG and CHI YAN, also shelter at this hut. YAN wants to kill TANG. GOU stops YAN. TANG helps GOU to heal LUNG.

They arrive the Cruel Valley. TSE is glad to see YAN. YAN is actually KOW CHIN YAN. AU reminds GOU to rescue TIN GOR and MEL TSE instigates YAN to kill YUNG. YUNG gives YAN some valuable advice.

TIN GOR tries the poisoned flower by himself so as to find out the way to counteract its toxic substance. TSE and AU suddenly disappear.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview:
AU heard that his father uses her to get the antidote form TSE so as to curry SHOU's favour. AU takes the opportunity to get the antidote for GOU.

TIN GOR awakes. He knows how to make the antidote. However, SHOU kills him. YUNG faces TSE's three challenges so as to get the antidote. CHI tries to capture the antidote from AU. GOU wants to kill CHI. CHI threatens GOU with AU's life. AU kills herself so that CHI could not threaten GOU. LUNG chases CHI to the cliff edge. She wants him to hand over the antidote to her. CHI eventually hands over the antidote to LUNG after a hard fight with her.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview:
LUNG has gone the next day. GOU follows her to the Heart Broken Cliff Edge, he finds that LUNG has carved message stating that she would see him again after sixteen years. GOU is very desperate. Yung persuades GOU to eat the 'Heart-Broken Grass' so that could lengthen his life span for another sixteen years.

Sixteen years later, FU married CHAI. SHEUNG and LO have grown up. The legend of the condor hero is very popular among city. SHEUNG goes to search to for it. She follows five ghosts from Shanxi to find the Condor Hero. They are arranged to compete with each other. However, five ghosts spoil Million Beasts Villa's plan.  The Villa's members aim to catch the Holy Fox with nine tails. However, the Holy Fox escape away. The hero is actually GOU, Her mediate between them and takes the initiative to bring SHEUNG to to the Black Dragon Lake Holy Fox.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview:
The owner of the Fox, LAU YING, refuses to hand over them the Fox. Meanwhile, YAT TANG brings CHI YAN who is seriously injured to see YING. GOU uses the sound of the flute to force YING to see them. YING wants to see CHOW PAK TUNG. In fact, the relationship between the four is very complicated. GOU and SHEUNG then go to find SHEUNG. CHOW PAK TUNG refuses to see them at the beginning. However, he eventually agrees to see them as he want to learn GOU’s new martial art.

TUNG TANG and YING all live at the Hundred Flower Valley. GOU gives three “Jade Bee Needles” to SHEUNG for defense.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview:
LU goes out to have a check but is killed by FOK DUO instead. LU even loses the “Beating Dog Stick” SHEUNG meets some bad people but is being rescued by a gallant. YUNG knows that this gallant is GOU.

CHING sets up meeting. Unexpectedly, a group of old veterans attend the meeting and talk with SHEUNG happily. The Beggar Sect is going to elect a new leader. Ho LOI devises to defeat CHAI and becomes very popular.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview:
GOU sends SHEUNG a few birthday gifts, the third gifts are the “Beating Dog Stick” and the disclosure of FOK DUO’s real identity. When FU wants to take off FOK’s Mask, he suddenly attacks her. Fortunately, she is saved by two small stores. In fact, SZE, GOU and CHAI are those who tried to save FU.

GOU talks with CHING and the others for a short while and leaves. He is shocked to know that those have no South Sea Nun from CHING. He goes to the Iron Gun Temple alone. He meets OR who proved to GOU that what his father had done was wrong. GOU feels sorry for CHING.

The Enchanter appreciates SHEUNG’s quality and intends to accept her to be his pupil. SHEUNG takes the chance to ask him to bring her to the Cruel Valley. She wants to persuade GOU not to attempt suicide.

YUNG finds SHEUNG. She asks TANG for help in lest Enchanter would get SHEUNG first. SHEUNG arrives the valley. She finds that GOU is going to jump down from the cliff……

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview:
They drown into a lake. GOU rescues SHEUNG. YUNG arrives. She wants to kill the Enchanter. She asks the twin condors for help. The Enchanter hurts the male condor. The male condor falls down from the cliff. The female condor rush to the bottom of the valley to rescue the male condor. It finds SHEUNG and brings her back to the cliff edge. YUNG asks SHEUNG to watch the Enchanter. The others then climb down to save GOU. However, they cannot find GOU at the bottom of the lake. They then go back to the cliff top. However, they find that even SHEUNG and the Enchanter have disappeared.

Now it comes to the climax of this story. Where has GOU gone? Will he meet LUNG again? Will SHEUNG be all right? Could CHING defeat the Mongolian? Please watch the final for the details.
